description: Equestrian Trail Routes is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Casey. Equestrian trail routes (lines) in the City of Casey categorized by location, construction type, and size. Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Assets, Community, Transport. Its keywords are Equestrian, Assets, Community, Transport, Recreation, Route. The portal shows 74 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
